name: Yaoi Story
source:
This is a Mad-Libs type of game where the user puts in character names, objects, body parts, and perversions that are added to the story. There are 5 locations to choose from that add variations to the plot-line. 

[From [url=http://www.renai.us/game/yaoistory.shtml]Ren'ai Archive[/url]]
